title: Degree-zero finite-twist evaluation as a flat single-object pairing
statement: For a commutative coefficient ring A killed by a positive N, a scheme T on which N is invertible, and any proof that its positive finite Tate line is flat, the fixed degree-zero evaluation of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-decomposition-maps] equals derived symmetry followed by the flat single-object pairing of [lem-pur-etale-single-functor-monoidal-compatibility] associated to the actual internal-Hom evaluation of its positive finite Tate line against its sheaf dual. The equality is independent of the supplied flatness proof.

source.place: Degree-zero evaluation identification in the proof of the projective-line decomposition.

proof.text: Expand the degree-zero evaluation, its degree-zero tensor comparison and the flat single-object pairing. Both use the actual internal-Hom evaluation. The positive Tate sheaf is the finite Tate line, the cached single functor is the canonical single functor, and flatness proofs are irrelevant; thus the two composites coincide definitionally.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero evaluation identification; elementary categorical composition of the prescribed comparisons.

theorem finiteTwistDegreeZeroEvaluation_pairing
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    (hL : ObjectProperty.flat (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA)) :
    p1DecompositionDegreeZeroEvaluation A N hN hA T hT =
      ((derivedTensorSymmetry (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf A N T hA (-1)))).app
        (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA T) ≫
      singleFunctorFlatPairing
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA)
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf A N T hA (-1))
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A T)
        hL
        ((ihom.ev (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA)).app
          (ordinaryFiniteConstant A T))
